set.body: Native package v1 binds run/revision/dataset IDs, recipe, canonical plan/input/result, source semantic identity and current source/frame checks, but does not persist the original dataset content/policy definition. RealRegistry enforces immutability within normal project use; a separately constructed cold document can alias the same dataset ID with changed time units or image/column mapping. Persist and verify a dataset-definition digest/snapshot under an explicit package/journal compatibility migration. Preserve v1 pins, define older-package handling truthfully, and prove changed units/mapping/policy cannot silently reinterpret archived coordinates/source fields. Independent review finding from verified readback slice bd-01M497P30NVXFGM9D3KFETEJ91; broader G1 remains open.
set.title: Native archives: bind the complete dataset definition
